content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This infrastructure enables digital creators in West Africa to sell products directly to customers worldwide without the constraints of traditional payment processors. By utilizing blockchain technology, creators can accept cryptocurrency payments, ensuring that they are not limited by geographical or financial barriers. This approach not only empowers creators but also provides them with full ownership of their sales process, making it a critical solution in regions where conventional payment options are lacking.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-14|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-16|The Real]] relies on a combination of free and open-source tools that work together to facilitate the entire ecommerce process. Digital products can be hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is managed through services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that transactions are secure and efficient. For example, USDT on the Tron network settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10, making it ideal for creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in West Africa, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, who are seeking to monetize their work without being hindered by payment platform restrictions. It is also beneficial for creators in countries like Pakistan and Bangladesh, where traditional payment options may be limited or unavailable. By leveraging blockchain payments and reliable infrastructure, these creators can reach a global audience and enhance their profitability.
Empower yourself with full ownership of your digital commerce stack.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include a hosting service, payment processor, backend logic, and data storage. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting environment for digital products, allowing creators to launch their stores effortlessly. NOWPayments handles payment processing, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages the necessary backend logic to confirm transactions. Finally, order data can be stored in a database like Supabase or even Google Sheets, giving creators complete control over their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your digital store. Next, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you configure it to support seamless payments. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for your backend logic and store product data in Supabase or Google Sheets. By following these steps, you can quickly deploy a fully functional ecommerce setup tailored to your needs.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographical restrictions for creators.

Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your online store. Next, integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions. Set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing orders. Store your product data in a secure location like Supabase or Google Sheets. Test the system to ensure that payments and product deliveries are functioning correctly. Launch your store and start promoting your digital products to a global audience.
